Perseid meteor shower and summer stargazing event. Hosted at Nora Naguri, a glamping facility.

A Star Sommelier® will guide you through observing shooting stars, the Summer Triangle, the Milky Way, and more using binoculars and telescopes.

【Date & Time】
August 12, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 7:00 p.m. – 8:30 p.m.
Registration opens: 6:30 p.m.; gathering: 6:50 p.m.
Rain date: August 13, 2026 (Thursday)

【Venue】
Nora Naguri, 607-1 Shimo-Naguri, Hanno, Saitama Prefecture

【Fees】
Adults: ¥1,000
Elementary school and younger: ¥500
Preschoolers: Free

【Capacity】
First-come, first-served; 20 people maximum. Pre-registration required.

【What to Bring】
Beverages, picnic blanket, or folding chair

【Cancellation Notice】
Decisions about postponement or cancellation due to weather will be announced by email by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the event.

For more information, visit the Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association website.
summary: 📢 August 12 (Wed) Hanno Stargazing Event – Perseid Meteor Shower Observation!
